# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 1 (Slot 76): Playable Mamluks Spice & Caliphate (oe_pmam_). Generated by gen_playable_mam.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Idempotent initialization of Slot 76 Playable Mamluks state.
oe_pmam_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_init } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_init value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_faction value = -20 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi value = 65 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_fifth_corps value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift Bahri (-100) vs Burji (+100) faction axis.
oe_pmam_shift_faction = {
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_faction add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_faction < -100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_faction value = -100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_faction > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_faction value = 100 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Shift Karimi merchant vitality (0..100) and refresh dynamic tier modifier.
oe_pmam_shift_karimi = {
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_karimi < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_karimi > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi value = 100 }
	}
	oe_pmam_sync_karimi_modifier = yes
}

# Country scope. Apply mode = replace tier modifier matching current Karimi vitality.
oe_pmam_sync_karimi_modifier = {
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_karimi >= 70 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_strain_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_strain_mod }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_boom_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_karimi <= 30 }
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_boom_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_boom_mod }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_strain_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_strain_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_pmam_karimi_strain_mod }
	}
}

# Country scope. Advance Fifth Corps firearm tier (0..4) and apply cadre modifier.
oe_pmam_bump_fifth_corps = {
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_fifth_corps add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_fifth_corps value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps > 4 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_fifth_corps value = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps >= 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_fifth_corps_cadre_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Country scope. Seal the Secret Venice-Mamluk Suez Timber Pact (cross-W2 global_var:oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact).
oe_pmam_seal_ven_timber_pact = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_ven_suez_timber_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:VEN NOT = { tag = VEN } }
		add_opinion = { modifier = oe_pmam_b_ven_timber_pact target = c:VEN }
		c:VEN = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_pmam_b_ven_timber_pact target = root }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmam_ven_levant_dividend_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Snapshot local + read-only oe_red_ + cross-W2 state for oe_pmam.90 readout.
oe_pmam_sync_readout = {
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_faction value = var:oe_pmam_faction }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_karimi value = var:oe_pmam_karimi }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_fifth value = var:oe_pmam_fifth_corps }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_ven_pact value = global_var:oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_ven_pact value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_iqta_reformed }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_iqta value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_iqta value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_canal_complete }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_canal value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_canal value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_canal_stage }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_red_canal value = global_var:oe_red_canal_stage }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_red_canal value = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_red_spice_access }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_red_spice value = global_var:oe_red_spice_access }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_rd_red_spice value = -1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) monthly driver for an individual Mamluk / Egyptian host.
oe_pmam_tick_host = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_pmam_is_host = yes
			NOT = { var:oe_pmam_country_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_country_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		oe_pmam_init_host = yes

		# Annual March Karimi drift based on enacted spice monopoly policy (BARE keys, ZERO policy: prefix).
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pmam_pol_karimi_free_charter }
				oe_pmam_shift_karimi = { amount = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pmam_pol_barsbay_tarh_monopoly }
				oe_pmam_shift_karimi = { amount = -3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_policy = oe_pmam_pol_venetian_alexandria_accord }
				oe_pmam_shift_karimi = { amount = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				oe_pmam_sync_karimi_modifier = yes
			}
		}

		# Chronological / milestone event dispatch (at most 1 event per host per month).
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:oe_pmam_ev_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
			if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1341 current_year <= 1355 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_1 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_1 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1375 current_year <= 1390 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_2 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_2 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1390
					current_year <= 1420
					oe_pmam_holds_two_sanctuaries = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_3 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_3 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1422 current_year <= 1445 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_4 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_4 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.4
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1450
					current_year <= 1500
					oe_pmam_holds_syria = yes
					OR = { country_exists = c:TUR country_exists = c:BYZ }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_5 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_5 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.5
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1498 current_year <= 1512 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_6 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_6 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.6
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1505 current_year <= 1525 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_7 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_7 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.7
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1508 current_year <= 1535 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_8 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_8 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.8
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1525
					current_year <= 1590
					owns = location:suez
					owns = location:cairo
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_9 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_9 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.9
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1540
					current_year <= 1620
					oe_pmam_holds_red_sea_nodes = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_10 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_10 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.10
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1570
					current_year <= 1650
					owns = location:cairo
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_11 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_11 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.11
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1600 current_year <= 1680 NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_12 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_12 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.12
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1680
					current_year <= 1740
					owns = location:alexandria
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_13 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_13 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.13
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1720 current_year <= 1775 owns = location:cairo NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_14 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_14 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.14
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { current_year >= 1760 current_year <= 1800 owns = location:suez NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_15 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_15 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.15
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					current_year >= 1430
					country_exists = c:ETH
					NOT = { tag = ETH }
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:ETH }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmam_ev_16 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_16 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ev_cnt add = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmam.16
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any country scope (Slot 76 scheduler or oe_pmam_fallback_pulse). Deduped once per calendar month.
oe_pmam_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_pmam_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmam_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:MAM }
			c:MAM = { oe_pmam_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:EGY }
			c:EGY = { oe_pmam_tick_host = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_pmam_adopted_host }
			oe_pmam_tick_host = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Adopt current human country as a Slot 76 Mamluk host for testing.
oe_pmam_dev_adopt_host = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_adopted_host value = 1 }
	oe_pmam_init_host = yes
	oe_pmam_sync_readout = yes
}

# Country scope. Page 76 Macro: Seal Venice-Mamluk Anti-Portuguese Timber Pact + Max Fifth Corps (tier 4).
oe_pmam_dev_macro_ven_pact_fifth_corps = {
	oe_pmam_dev_adopt_host = yes
	oe_pmam_seal_ven_timber_pact = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_fifth_corps value = 3 }
	oe_pmam_bump_fifth_corps = { amount = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmam_karimi value = 80 }
	oe_pmam_sync_karimi_modifier = yes
	oe_pmam_sync_readout = yes
}

# Country scope. Reset Slot 76 variables for clean re-testing.
oe_pmam_dev_reset = {
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_init
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_adopted_host
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_faction
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_karimi
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_corps

	remove_variable = oe_pmam_fifth_cd
	remove_global_variable = oe_pmam_ven_timber_pact

	remove_variable = oe_pmam_ev_2

	remove_variable = oe_pmam_ev_4
	remove_variable = oe_pmam_ev_5

}
